content: What you seek is seeking you.
author: Rumi
story: Drawing from the heart of Sufi mysticism, Rumi challenged the notion of a one-way spiritual search toward an unreachable horizon. Just as thirst in a traveler's throat proves the objective existence of water, Rumi realized that genuine spiritual longing is not a monologue—it is the magnetic echo of truth calling the seeker back to itself. The desire to find meaning is proof that meaning has already laid claim to you.
reflectionPrompt: If the quiet yearning in your heart is already an invitation waiting to meet you, what first step towards it are you hesitating to take?
